summary.text: Patrick Flannery is a Republican state representative who has represented District 96 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Flannery earned a B.A. from Georgetown College and a J.D. from Northern Kentucky University Chase School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and businessman.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Local Government Committee and serves on the Judiciary, Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, and Natural Resources and Energy committees.
